sources.scope: Published SIGEF Privado rural certification records returned for municipio=Teresina. Bounded positive parcel coverage; urban IPTU/CTM coverage and citywide completeness are unestablished.
sources.licenceNote: Public anonymous viewer-backed access. No explicit vector reuse licence found; INTERPI/INCRA terms require follow-up.
caveats: Rural certification subset, not the municipal urban IPTU/CTM cadastre. No hit at the frozen city locator was observed in discovery.
Complete query results mean complete enumeration of this published municipality selector, not complete city cadastral coverage. No server bbox filter is established.
Historical discovery observed 901 records and 55 centroid/boundary mismatches. These counts were not rerun during initial qualification; edge records are preserved unchanged, never clipped.

Native geometry explicitly declares EPSG:4674 and has Z coordinates. Wire axes are observed longitude, latitude. Coordinates and Z are preserved without fitted shifts. Precise SIRGAS2000/WGS84 realization, epoch and operation accuracy need second-pass review.
Current/historic validity, wider overlaps, exact-ID long-term stability, licensing and survey alignment remain follow-ups.
The term parameter is a search. Adapter exhausts pages and requires exact properties.id equality; unsolicited display attributes are discarded.

jurisdiction.basis: Official INTERPI Terras.PI rural land platform integrates SIGEF/SNCI–INCRA; observed SIGEF Privado polygons via Teresina municipality selector.
